messages:
marie_cs: AuroraTech wants to flip to annual billing early and consolidate 3 seats into an enterprise bundle. They asked for a 5% term discount + one onboarding workshop. Need legal + finance for PO path.

alex_sales: Buyer prefers PO and monthly invoices. Approved 5% discount if legal signs off. I shared commercial summary.

toni_legal: We'll need a short addendum for the onboarding deliverable and DPA attachment. Drafting now, ETA today.

jose_fin: Finance requires vendor code AT-310 and Net30 on main contract. If they want monthly invoices we accept PO referencing AT-310.

noah_enable: Enablement can deliver a 90-min workshop. Need 3 technical contacts and preferred dates. We'll include a 4-question feedback pulse after week 1.

rita_se: SE note: last month we saw increased error rates on batching layer. Recommend we include a perf verification step during onboarding.

marie_cs: Actions: @toni_legal draft addendum + DPA; @jose_fin confirm vendor code (AT-310 ok); @alex_sales confirm contact list; @noah_enable prep invite.

toni_legal: Uploaded redline: https://drive.company/aurora_addendum_v1. Added onboarding scope and DPA reference.

alex_sales: Contact list sent to Enablement. CFO confirmed PO route. I'll prepare DocuSign once legal finalizes.

doc_bot: DocuSign envelope created -> https://docusign.company/aurora_envelope (signers: CFO, procurement).

marie_cs: Flagging in Gainsight as "early-annual". Please notify if signature delayed >3 business days.

doc_bot: Envelope status: completed at 6066660030. PO AT-310 received. Onboarding workshop scheduled Apr 18 13:00 PT. Closing loop, will share feedback results.
